title.es: Fábrica de Finks de Bioshock Infinite

generated.description: A large industrial factory themed after Finks Factory from the game Bioshock Infinite, built mostly from stone bricks, quartz pillars, and terracotta accents with iron bars and spruce details. It stands about 79 wide, 82 high, and 111 deep, with a tall stepped front block, rows of windows, and a sprawling base. The interior includes chests, hoppers, droppers, flower pots, a jukebox and record player, and control blocks, suggesting working details.
